ns2:course.label: China Under the Qing Dynasty
ns2:course.description: The period of Manchu domination in China (1644-1912); emphasis on Chinese reactions to Western influences during the nineteenth century. Same as EALC 420. 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 4 graduate hours.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as EALC 420. 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 4 graduate hours.
